title: Microsoft Purview DLP: adaptive scopes for SharePoint sites
summary: The briefing passes: it distinguishes Microsoft's roadmap plans from the documented preview and does not invent an attachment command, default, or feature-specific licence. Two minor clarifications would make the UI rows clearer about where their paths stop.

claims.quote: Microsoft Purview: Data Loss Prevention- Adaptive Scopes for DLP for SharePoint

claims.where: controls[0].ui and controls[0].api; Governance controls; Open questions
claims.claim: No usable documented UI route or fully described automation operation attaches an adaptive scope to a SharePoint DLP policy.
claims.quote: Searched: DLP SharePoint adaptive scopes select policy; SharePointAdaptiveScopes New Set DlpCompliancePolicy values. Opened DLP reference, creation pages, New/Set-DlpCompliancePolicy and adaptive scopes; no SharePoint wizard selection or attachment value semantics found.

claims.claim: New-DlpCompliancePolicy lists the SharePointAdaptiveScopes parameter without describing its operation or the values identifying a scope.
Set-DlpCompliancePolicy documents no SharePoint adaptive scope parameter or method to change these scopes on an existing policy.
claims.quote: Searched: SharePointAdaptiveScopes New Set DlpCompliancePolicy values; searched fetched Set-DlpCompliancePolicy text for SharePoint.*Adaptive, Adaptive.*SharePoint and AdaptiveScopes. No SharePoint adaptive parameter appeared in syntax or parameter headings.

claims.claim: Set-DlpCompliancePolicy lists adaptive scope parameters for Exchange, OneDrive, Teams and endpoint locations.
claims.quote:
### -EndpointDlpAdaptiveScopes
### -ExchangeAdaptiveScopes
### -OneDriveAdaptiveScopes
### -TeamsAdaptiveScopes

claims.claim: Microsoft Purview portal > Settings > Roles and scopes > Adaptive scopes > + Create scope reaches adaptive scope creation.
claims.quote: Sign in to the Microsoft Purview portal > Settings > Roles and scopes > Adaptive scopes. On the Adaptive scopes page, select + Create scope.
claims.fix: Extend the path to 'Settings > Roles and scopes > Adaptive scopes > + Create scope > Full directory > SharePoint sites'. Add to the row note: 'Then select the attributes or properties and enter their values to build the dynamic membership.' The cited page documents these remaining choices.

claims.claim: New-AdaptiveScope -Name "<scope name>" -LocationType Site -FilterConditions <hashtable> creates a site adaptive scope with filter conditions.
claims.quote: Use the New-AdaptiveScope cmdlet to create adaptive scopes in your organization. The LocationType parameter specifies the location where the adaptive scope filter is defined. Valid values are: User; Group (Microsoft 365 group); Site. FilterConditions: Type: PswsHashtable

claims.claim: The New-AdaptiveScope reference describes adaptive scopes as used in retention policies and retention label policies, not as a DLP-specific command.
claims.quote: Adaptive scopes (or static scopes) are used in retention policies and retention label policies.

claims.claim: The printed Microsoft Purview DLP wizard path follows the cited Custom policy procedure through the SharePoint sites location selector.
claims.quote: Select Data loss prevention > Policies > + Create policy. Select Enterprise applications & devices. Select Custom from both the Categories list and the Regulations list. Accept the default Full directory on the Assign admin units page. Choose where to apply the policy.
claims.fix: Keep the supported path and add to controls[2].note: 'The UI path reaches the SharePoint sites location selector; the cited procedure does not show selection of individual SharePoint sites.' This narrows the UI's claim without inventing further labels.

claims.claim: New-DlpCompliancePolicy -Name "<policy name>" -SharePointLocation "<site URL>" creates a DLP policy scoped to a named SharePoint site rather than an attribute query.
claims.quote: The SharePointLocation parameter specifies the SharePoint sites to include in the DLP policy. You identify the site by its URL value, or you can use the value All to include all sites.

claims.claim: No dedicated Microsoft Learn page for SharePoint DLP adaptive scopes was found at the time of writing.
claims.quote: Searched: SharePoint DLP adaptive scopes attach scope Scope Manager role Site template existing policy rollout 549288; DLP SharePoint adaptive scopes select policy. Results document the feature in the DLP reference and surrounding adaptive scope guidance, not a dedicated feature page.

claims.claim: Microsoft has not described user-visible changes specifically caused by this new SharePoint DLP scoping feature.
claims.quote: Searched: SharePoint DLP adaptive scopes pricing billing meter default rollout user impact. Read roadmap, DLP reference and deployment guidance; general DLP actions and notifications are documented, but no user-visible change specific to arrival of adaptive scoping was found.

claims.claim: The documented general adaptive scope mechanism separates creation of a scope from selecting it for a policy.
claims.quote: Create as many adaptive scopes as you need. You can select one or more adaptive scopes when you create your policy.

claims.claim: DLP policy configuration requires DLP policy-management permissions, distinct from the Scope Manager permission needed to create a scope.
claims.quote: Unrestricted policies are created and managed by users in these role groups: Compliance administrator; Compliance data administrator; Information Protection; Information Protection Admin; Security administrator
